policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Portable Equipment and Accidental Damage Edition
description: During a drive from Berlin to Munich, a brand-new mac with a price point of 1400€ was in use on the passenger seat -it was only bought a couple of days earlier. The vehicle had to make a sharp turn to avoid a tree, and the laptop was thrown against the car door. It came away with a crack running across the middle of the screen and damage to the lower right corner.

lines.1: Laptop damage payment — cracked screen and lower- right-corner impact damage, thrown against car door during evasive turn | 1 pcs
